title: Hold an asbestos removal licence
what: Hold a class A licence to remove friable asbestos, and a class A or B licence to remove non-friable asbestos.

sources.title: Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 485(1) (current republication (R47, from 29 November 2025; Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 | Subordinate laws))
sources.quote: (1) A person must not carry out the removal of the following at a workplace unless the person, or the person on whose behalf the work is carried out, holds a Class A asbestos removal licence: (a) friable asbestos;

sources.title: Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 487(1) (current republication (R47, from 29 November 2025; Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 | Subordinate laws))
sources.quote: (1) A person must not carry out the removal of the following at a workplace unless the person, or the person on whose behalf the work is carried out, holds a Class B asbestos removal licence or a Class A asbestos removal licence: (a) non-friable asbestos or ACM;

administration.who: WorkSafe ACT (Work Health and Safety Commissioner)
administration.note: Issues asbestos removal licences and enforces the duty.

sources.title: Work Health and Safety Act 2011 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 251, words naming the body (found 12 Nov 2026)

triggers.note: When the business removes friable asbestos, or any non-friable asbestos.

reach.note: Any business that removes asbestos; mostly demolition, construction trades and specialist asbestos removalists.

confidence_note: In the ACT the class B licence covers removing any non-friable asbestos or ACM (s 487(1)(a)), without the 10 square metre allowance in the other states' regulations.

assessment.summary: Removing friable asbestos, or more than 10 square metres of non-friable asbestos, needs a class A or class B asbestos removal licence held by the business doing it.

marks.reason: A licence, with qualified supervisors and set procedures, is needed before a business can take on asbestos removal work.

assessment.confidence_note: Marked from the licence's design against the framework's guide; the health benefit is not counted by the framework.
